title: Hoffman's team of mathematicians working on trace-logic conjectures

tellings.quote: So there are so we're assembling a team right now of of mathematicians. We have all these conjectures that we've put out publicly conjectures

plain: Donald Hoffman, a researcher who studies perception and consciousness, says that in 2026 he is putting together a team of mathematicians. He says his group has published a number of open mathematical ideas, which he calls conjectures, from a framework known as trace logic, and the team will try to work them out. If his ideas hold up, they would give a mathematical basis to his view that reality is quite different from what we perceive.
